sources.beginner: hand-calc for spring rate, buoyed weight and fluid load (beginner m01-m05 print E, 7.85, the rod weights); natural frequency is handed over by the prompt; stroke and rated displacement need the 720-angle linkage, which only the Suite unit card computes (1 dp)
sources.intermediate: static stretch by hand; the march outputs (plunger stroke, PPRL, MPRL, PRHP, produced) are engine-only and no surface can be set to OBAGI-27 (panels select-only, Suite derives intake/fillage)
sources.advanced: all six are balancing / Goodman / Gibbs engine outputs on the OBAGI-27 card; no surface can be set to the case

fields.evidence: 1/sum(12 L/(E A)) over 1825 ft of 1 in, 2140 of 7/8, 2120 of 3/4 at E 30.5e6 = 237.957145; reproduced exactly. Tol is a relative 2e-7 of the value (about seven significant figures); the panels already print 9 decimals, so an editable panel clears it.
fields.notes: pd-string-explorer prints Kr at 9 decimals (/root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/rodpump/StringExplorer.jsx:157) but only for the teaching strings (select at :148).

fields.evidence: 13523.24 x (1 - 0.94/7.85) = 11903.896611; reproduced exactly. The prompt states the 13,523.24 lb weight in air (exact: 1825 x 2.904 + 2140 x 2.224 + 2120 x 1.634), so only the factor is the learner's.
fields.notes: The air weight in the prompt is a large hint but not the answer.

fields.display_ref: src/components/course/panels/rodpump/StringExplorer.jsx Typed view, Tile 'Engine scan fundamental' fmt(r.engineScanSpm, 12)

fix.redesign: keep string_natural_freq_spm but drop the two figures (40.15458511 and 1.15865923) from the prompt's traps and free checks, keeping the qualitative check that the tapered note must exceed the uniform one; then give pd-string-explorer an editable taper so the learner reads the engine scan fundamental at its 12-decimal print. Without the panel change the field becomes unobtainable, because the tapered note is a transfer-matrix scan (beginner m03 l01).

fields.recommendation: The answer is 40.15458511 x 1.15865923 = 46.52548066, 1.1e-7 from the key against tol 9.4e-6, so the prompt hands it over. Remove the numbers and pair that with an editable string view.
fields.evidence: Typing 1 in x 1825 ft, 7/8 in x 2140 ft, 3/4 in x 2120 ft into the typed string view returns the engine scan fundamental equal to the key within tol 9.4e-6 at its 12 decimal print (panelCapstoneGuard.test.js 'typing the string the prompt states'). The prompt no longer prints the uniform fundamental or the taper factor, so the product route is gone. The view's default (ODUMA-4) is in teachingQuantities and lands on no graded answer.

shipped.prompt: string_natural_freq_spm is the product of two numbers the prompt printed (the 40.15458511 spm uniform fundamental and the 1.15865923 taper factor), so 40.15458511 x 1.15865923 = 46.52548066 passed without any work (B5 finding 4). The two figures are dropped from the trap and the free check, keeping

fields.source_ref: src/components/course/panels/rodpump/CardExplorer.jsx:666 (typed mode: the case typed as the prompt states it)
fields.evidence: A typed well mode on CardExplorer.jsx (typedWellCard / typedWellBalance in rodPumpLab.js: buildRodString, conventionalGeometry, runRodPumpDesign at the engine's default marching parameters, balanceUnit, modifiedGoodman and diagnoseCard, the chain of the capstone derivation) marches the well the learner types. Typing the prompt's well prints the value within tol; yourCase.test.js proves it, that the ODUMA-4 default lands on no graded answer, and that a retyped damping, unbalance or service factor misses.
fields.notes: The Suite Rod Pump Design Studio cannot be set to OBAGI-27: it derives intake pressure and fillage from its well model (contexts/RodPumpDesignContext.jsx:139 designFormFrom, utils/production/rodPump.js:69 intake pressure and :127 fillage), so the stated 210/2680 psia, fillage 0.853 and efficiency 0.86 cannot be typed; and it prints 0 to 2 decimals (components/rodpump/LoadsPanel.jsx:73-134, DiagnosticsPanel.jsx:101-107, RodStressPanel.jsx:80). Its diagnostic also re-reads the design card rounded to 2 dp position and whole-lb load (RodPumpDesignContext.jsx useDesignCardForDiagnosis).
